name: Views CSS Grid
description: A Views style plugin for rendering results in a customizable CSS Grid.
project_description:
Simple views-formatter provides low-level grid-css for views-style and views-row.

 Useful for prototyping but also a solid solution in production when css-grid's are applied only in one view. For me, this happens often, since i'm nesting special designed views into Layout-Builder Layouts.

 
 Usage of auto-fill and auto-fit to create homogene, responsive grids
 Most css-grid options available
